basic_info.description: Outer Mission charmer, move in ready! Located on a short non-through traffic street! Super location! Three spacious bedrooms, full updated bath w/shower over tub and heated floor. Very functional efficient kitchen with gas stove. Large light bright living and formal dining rm. Refinished hardwood floors, fresh paint, updated fixtures, new central heat, updated electrical system, and seismic strengthening. Downstairs at street level is a large garage/basement w/laundry hook ups and garage door opener. (Possible basement conversion to additional living space, subject to SF city approval). Fenced backyard for outdoor entertaining. Walk to the Balboa Park BART station.  Minutes to the 280 freeway, Whole Foods Market, and City College of San Francisco. Seller has diligently prepared this home for sale. Bring your buyer's with confidence to this turnkey property.
